---
title: "AD688: Fashion and Apparel Career Evaluation - Group 7"
---

## Project Overview

This project evaluates analytics-related career opportunities within the apparel and fashion industry using job-posting data from the MET Career Compass dataset.

The analysis focuses on a narrowly defined market built around NAICS 458 and a verified list of apparel and fashion employers. The current filtered dataset contains 19 job postings and is intended to provide a descriptive view of the selected market rather than represent the broader analytics labor market.

## Project Sections

Use the navigation bar above to explore the project:

- **Introduction** — project scope, career pathway, and industry context
- **Data Preparation** — filtering, cleaning, and preparation of the analytical dataset
- **Market Baseline** — current job volume, salary, geography, experience, work arrangement, and employer patterns
- **Skill Gap Analysis** — comparison of market skill requirements with relevant career skills
- **Career Evaluation** — evaluation of career opportunities using the project findings
- **Final Recommendations** — overall conclusions and recommendations

The Market Baseline currently provides the descriptive foundation for the later skill-gap and career-evaluation stages of the project.
